ancestry_rule: FRANK/Clay/ClayGraph/UnifiedDB statements derived from the same project lineage are collapsed and are not counted as independent replication.

reviews.assumption: ClayCode surface spelling may vary while one deterministic typed canonical IR remains the semantic identity/compilation layer.
independent_evidence: fresh full-current-G9 executable proxy: baseline surface 61/86, strict canonical normalization candidate 86/86
MLIR independently separates generic operation form from custom assembly forms while retaining common operation semantics
WIT independently uses explicit lexical token/grammar categories rather than arbitrary prose-word semantics
reviews.counterhypothesis: A finite declared bare-relation surface or @relation surface may preserve the same typed canonical IR with fewer migration/token/reader costs than strict normalization.
reviews.falsifier: Matched full-corpus N/S/D experiment shows another surface has equal deterministic semantic identity and materially lower total parser/migration/reader cost, or strict normalization cannot roundtrip intended typed AST.

reviews.assumption: FRANK v0.1 adaptive visual learning requires new ClayCode core syntax.
independent_evidence: current required learner state is expressible as versioned records, typed outcomes, provenance, budgets, promotion/rollback/replay contracts in existing general-purpose semantics
no full learner compile/replay counterexample currently demonstrates semantic inadequacy
reviews.counterhypothesis: A full H1 learner compile/replay will expose an unrepresentable state transition requiring a new primitive.
reviews.falsifier: Executable H1-to-ClayCode compilation fails for a semantic reason that cannot be repaired in parser/runtime/stdlib/FFI without changing core semantics.

reviews.assumption: Parser acceptance can confer semantic relation identity or effect authority.
independent_evidence: declared-relation concurrent experiment rejected 50000/50000 unknown relation typos while a naive arbitrary-infix parser accepted them
current UnifiedDB capability/authority/receipt state is explicitly separate from textual affordance representation
reviews.counterhypothesis: A parser-only relation mechanism could remain safe if every accepted token were globally reserved and immutable.
reviews.falsifier: Production implementation proves parser-level reservation alone preserves versioned typed relation semantics and authority boundaries across dialect evolution without resolver state.
